verdict.rationale: Extend is API-first and can be driven entirely without a UI. It has API-key authentication, a pip-installable SDK and an official CLI. Every processing endpoint runs in sync and async modes with webhooks. Test API keys keep automated runs away from production data, and stable processor IDs, immutable workflow versions and programmatic eval-set runs suit repeatable CI pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs or examples (e.g., CI pipeline recipes), detailed CLI documentation beyond the page title, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
